label: Scenario input from the 2022 record, not a forecast
basis: Water levels are the five USGS storm-tide sensors around Fort Myers Beach during Hurricane Ian (the pier peaked at 13.23 ft NAVD88 at 14:39), blended by distance over today's USGS 3DEP ground and joined to the Gulf and Estero Bay. Minute 0 is Lee County's 07:00 Zone A order on 27 September. Wind is the NOAA Fort Myers gauge, 22 km inland.

sources.label: Bucci et al., NHC Tropical Cyclone Report: Hurricane Ian (AL092022), revised 2026
USGS Short-Term Network, Hurricane Ian (event 325): storm-tide sensors FLLEE03382, 03284, 03288, 03246, 03287 and high-water marks
Lee County, Hurricane Ian After-Action Report (2023): evacuation order times
NOAA CO-OPS Fort Myers 8725520: water level and wind
